caption: Toda-Yamamoto Granger F-statistics at lags 1–12, both directions. SPY → NAHB HMI (vermillion) clears the 5% critical line at EVERY lag (F = 47.2 at lag 1, all p < 0.0001); NAHB HMI → SPY (pale blue) clears it at 1 lag only (lag 5, p = 0.028) — an isolated cell against 12-for-12 in reverse. The asymmetry is the signature of a lagging indicator: the market moves builder sentiment, not the other way around.
narrative_alignment_note: Reverse direction rendered as the visually primary series per Lead dispatch — the reverse-causality result IS the finding; all F/p values re-read from CSVs.
